## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      18 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 22.07.2026 - 12.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _MichaelMather2026_, 11.10.2026, 1/5: "Had been using this for years. My god what is this new interface update. Super buggy, blocks that I deleted keeping magically reappearing. The app even adds random blocks I never created. What on earth is going on over there at Opal. How can it be this bad."
            2. _Tomito6_, 02.10.2026, 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13.09.2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
